policy.strict_verbatim_rule: strict when non-OA, or when the text licence is known and not permissive; unknown text licence follows the access-only rule

verification_scope: content-policy checks and bound artifact integrity

checks.name: access_tier_oa
checks.summary: Every included paper's access.type is in the OA allowed set (v0 OA-only).  (29 included papers checked)

checks.name: strip_verbatim_similarity
checks.summary: P2 classes: strict=2, known text licence permissive=27, unknown text licence=0; permissive regime=27 (includes known permissive and unknown text licence). Strict when non-OA, or when the text licence is known and not permissive; unknown text licence follows the access-only rule. Strict per-span cap 300 chars and cumulative cap 1500 chars/DOI; near-verbatim similarity is checked for all spans. (2639 verbatim spans scanned)

checks.name: pii_dual_use
checks.summary: Two-tier PII / dual-use scan of verbatim quote spans (pii_config=2026-10-29.1).  (2639 spans scanned)

checks.name: provenance_doi_license
checks.summary: Every skill carries provenance (source DOI or repository) + a license SPDX tag.  (803 skills checked)

checks.name: composite_workflows
checks.summary: Composite workflow super-skills resolve to real leaves with a valid typed DAG and matching layout count.  (2 workflows checked)

checks.name: layout_packaging
checks.summary: Each skill dir holds SKILL.md (+ optional skill_kb.json) within budget; skills_index.json matches the leaf directories.  (803 indexed, 803 on disk)  (803 skills checked)

checks.name: skill_frontmatter
checks.summary: Every SKILL.md, routing scaffolds included, has YAML frontmatter that parses to a mapping.

checks.name: unit_closure
checks.summary: Pack indexes match their leaves; declared helpers stay inside each unit.

checks.name: peer_review_claim
checks.summary: No advertised file says peer-reviewed when the corpus holds preprint or deposit DOIs (10.1101, 10.48550, 10.26434, 10.5281).

checks.name: leaf_text_floor
checks.summary: No leaf description reads 'Use when when'; no frontmatter evidence span is shared by more than 10 leaves.  (803 of 803 leaves, 100.0 %, carry no frontmatter evidence span; 73, 9.1 %, carry no evidence of either kind)

checks.name: catalogue_membership
checks.summary: Collection counts and advertised members match disk and published indexes.  (1 catalogues checked)
